# PersonaMem-v2 official scoring reference

The verbatim reference comes from
[`bowen-upenn/PersonaMem-v2`](https://github.com/bowen-upenn/PersonaMem-v2)
at `d29d91d016add354e459dfeb0d24af08bc402e2a`.

- `official_scorer.py`: `MemAgent/verl/utils/reward_score/implicit_persona.py`.
- `official_mcq_fragment.txt`: option construction and question formatting from
  `MemAgent/data/data_preprocess.py`; exact line bounds and digests are recorded
  in `data/datasets/personamem_v2/specs/scorer.json`.

These files provide an independent differential reference. They contain no corpus,
reference answers, model outputs or test receipts. Credit: Bowen Jiang and the
PersonaMem-v2 authors, *PersonaMem-v2: Towards Personalized Intelligence via
Learning Implicit User Personas and Agentic Memory*.
